description: Browse TIDAL albums, artists, tracks, playlists, artwork and related catalog resources.

tidal_new_artist_album_trigger.description: Runs for each new artist album in TIDAL. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, meta.replacement, type

tidal_new_artist_track_trigger.description: Runs for each new artist track in TIDAL. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, meta.replacement, type

parameters.description: Collapse by options for getting artist tracks. Available options: FINGERPRINT, ID. FINGERPRINT option might collapse similar tracks based entry fingerprints while collapsing by ID always returns all available items.
parameters.name: collapse_by

tidal_new_or_updated_artist_album_trigge.description: Runs for each artist album added or changed in TIDAL. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, meta.replacement, type

tidal_new_or_updated_artist_track_trigge.description: Runs for each artist track added or changed in TIDAL. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, meta.replacement, type

parameters.description: Collapse by options for getting artist tracks. Available options: FINGERPRINT, ID. FINGERPRINT option might collapse similar tracks based entry fingerprints while collapsing by ID always returns all available items.
parameters.name: collapse_by

tidal_new_or_updated_playlist_item_trigg.description: Runs for each playlist item added or changed in TIDAL. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, meta.addedAt, meta.itemId, meta.replacement, type

tidal_new_playlist_item_trigger.description: Runs for each new playlist item in TIDAL. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, meta.addedAt, meta.itemId, meta.replacement, type
